stage: S3 confirmatory study (fresh creatures; the only confirmatory evidence of the walking-recovery research)
status: DRAFT until the owner approves the freeze; the freeze commit hash is the registration
question: At an equal TOTAL rollout budget, does Nemotron directing the engineering decisions (which experiments to run, which subsystems of controller and body to change, how to spend the budget) make more genuinely failing, never-seen creatures walk than the best non-AI strategy we built?
development_history: M1 (G1 PROCEED: joint 17-D search 6/12), S2 (R* = 2000; primary comparator FIX; G2 PASS), S2b (director prompt v2 = the one dev revision of the AI in this design; Ultra ineligible under G2), L2 (G3 FAIL: no experience arm), iteration 3 / S4a (G4 FAIL: closed-loop mechanism invention 4/24 vs fix15 11/24; not in S3). Reports: experiments/walk_recovery/*/REPORT_*.md. Every number there is development data; none of it is pooled here.

methods.what: NemotronDirector prompt v2, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, production config (thinking off), probe/subspace order shuffled per pipeline (recorded seed); live calls through the authoritative inference ledger
FixedDirector(probes=(opt_placement, opt_body, opt_posture)) - the PRIMARY COMPARATOR (S2 rule)
blind CMA-ES over all 17 control dims + 4 body params
blind CMA-ES over the 17 control dims

pairing: for each creature every method uses the same seeds (all roles) and the same noise seed
accounting: equal TOTAL budget: start evaluation, every probe, every plan (incl. rejected/discarded), screening and every round charged (walk_pipelines.Budget; ledger == sum of lines <= budget asserted per unit); final validation/confirmation not charged and identical for all methods
recovery_rule: recovery.full_recovery_v1 (unchanged): aggregate PASS (>= 80% walking) on 24 held-out validation seeds under VARIATION_PRESET AND verdict_v1 VERIFIED_IMPROVEMENT vs the unmodified original AND a 20 s confirmation on 24 further seeds (>= 80% walking, median speed >= the creature's min_speed, no body dragging). PARTIAL_IMPROVEMENT is never counted as recovery.

primary_hypothesis.statement: ai_v2 fully recovers more creatures than fix
primary_hypothesis.test: exact one-sided McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs, H1: ai-only > fix-only), alpha = 0.05
primary_hypothesis.outcome: FULL_RECOVERY per creature (binary), paired by creature

secondary_hypotheses.test: exact one-sided McNemar each; Holm-Bonferroni over the family at alpha = 0.05

exploratory: fix vs cma_joint, rand vs fix, cma_joint vs cma_ctrl (two-sided exact McNemar, reported without multiplicity claims)
region-cluster sensitivity: exact sign test on per-region differences (ai_v2 minus fix full-recovery counts)
partial-improvement rates, mean validation walking fractions, rollouts used, AI decision patterns (body co-design rate, first probes, refutations), AI cost and latency
itt_and_errors: an AI pipeline whose director returns nothing valid keeps the start candidate (not recovered); a unit error is recorded and counted as not recovered in the primary analysis, and listed; no unit is rerun; one analysis after all units completed
power: 48 pairs; an exact one-sided McNemar detects e.g. 7 vs 1 (p = 0.035) or 9 vs 2 (p = 0.033) discordant pairs; a null result is a valid outcome and will be reported as such

frozen_components.director_prompt: director.build_system_prompt('v2', order_seed) with the recorded order seed per pipeline

execution: batch VM (cpu-d3 64vcpu), 12 shards x 3 workers; outputs to git-ignored artifacts/, pulled before any sync; authoritative inference ledger on the VM, returned afterwards
inference_cap: <= 8 requests per pipeline; global ledger caps $15 / 1,500 requests
wording_rule: report classical-optimiser recoveries, the AI's marginal contribution at equal budget, and the unchanged/harder evaluation conditions separately; never call a partial improvement a recovery; unrecovered = 'not recovered within 2,000 rollouts'

panel_rule.rule: creature_gen.generate_panel: guided bodies from GEN_DIST; accepted iff the R2-transfer walk challenge on 8 selection seeds is aggregate FAIL with <= 1 walking seed; region cap ceil(48/24)+1 = 3; every draw recorded; generated ONCE after the freeze commit, before any method runs; its sha256 is stored in every unit

selection_note: selection v2 for EVERY arm (walk_pipelines selection='v2'): the final screening also requires the screen median to reach the original's screen median + 0.5 m (verdict_v1's walk minimum effect) before walking count decides; the shared fix approved with iteration 3 for a method-independent artifact (a stable walker that does not out-distance a runaway original cannot be verified). The original's screen is charged to every arm. verdict_v1 itself is unchanged. The ai_v2 prompt is unchanged (byte-identical to S2b).
